description: Grow a circle from each graph node clipped to its Voronoi cell (or a capsule from each edge) — one Space per grown cell. Radius is wireable to animate the tessellation.
instructions:
Grows geometry from an incoming graph, clipped to Voronoi cells — one output Space per grown cell. `mode` = Voronoi Vertices (a circle of `radius` from each NODE, clipped to that node's Voronoi cell — small r → separate disks, large r → the full Voronoi diagram) or Voronoi Edges (an equal-radius capsule from each SEGMENT; `intersect` lets capsules meet along the segment-Voronoi bisectors → one Space per segment). `sides` sets circle/cap resolution.

The `gin-boundary` input is the Space the cells grow inside (else the upstream Skeleton's source, or the bounding box). One handle per cell, or a single bundle. Radius is wireable — animate it to watch the tessellation assemble.
